title: The eight reference operators were not covered by any Excel comparison
upstream_status_verbatim: not covered by this run; they need a reference-fixture generator
status_plain: Eight of the 23 operators - OP_RANGE_REF, OP_INTERSECTION_REF, OP_UNION_REF, OP_SPILL_REF, the three OP_TRIM_REF_* and OP_IMPLICIT_INTERSECTION - carry no Excel comparison of any kind. The operator structural sweep says so directly and gives the reason: they need a reference-fixture generator that does not exist. Two other streams corroborate independently, both noting that the reference operators use RefsVisibleInAdapter and are a different structural family. This is an affirmative finding of absence, and it is why the 99/99 and the 21-case sweep must never be described as covering "the operators".
open_question: A reference-fixture generator does not exist; no reference-operator corpus exists.
reader_warning: No number on any other operator record reaches these eight. They are not "assumed correct"; they are unmeasured.
